The computational model is based on a finite element technique using the Galerkin variant of the method of moments.
The expansion and weighting functions are piecewise linear, relative to a solid element with eight nodes.
The model is fully three-dimensional and can account for the presence of a thin, perfectly conducting enclosure.
The model can be used to analyze the transient electromagnetic field coupling into metallic cavities or enclosures.
The paper does not present specific numerical results or findings, but focuses on describing the computational approach and its capabilities.
